programme.desc: 'S23/E10 - The Power Of Jane'. Actress Jane Krakowski teams up with chef Michael Symon to steal Bobby's spotlight. They bring in no-nonsense chefs Attila Bollok and Matthew Spinner.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: 'S23/E11 - Don't Fiddle Around!'. Actress Teri Hatcher joins chef Josh Capon to take down Bobby. Chef Geoff Lazlo faces off against chef Daniel Wright to show Bobby who's boss in the kitchen.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S53/E4 - Grilling On The Edge'. Four chefs with a talent for live-fire cooking bring their passion to the kitchen. Second-guessing in round two leaves one chef confused about the main protein.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S24/E4 - Summer Grillin' Games Part 4'. Guy Fieri treats the remaining five chefs to a Flavortown vacation! Whose destination dinner will earn them 'Best Dish' and a spot in the finale?

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S35/E9 - Destination Dishes'. The hosts share recipes inspired by memorable vacations, from German party cheese dip to classic Italian meatballs.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S38/E1 - From Chicken To Caribbean'. Guy Fieri hits up the-bomb fried chicken in Omaha, real deal Caribbean in Cincinnati and over-the-top chicken and dumplings in Redmond, Oregon.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S59/E9 - Legends: Scott Conant'. Four chefs return to the kitchen with a personal invitation from legendary judge Scott Conant. A vegetable is a true test in the first basket.

programme.title: Cupcake Championship
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Christmas In July'. It's a showdown of Christmas cupcakes as four top bakers compete to create edible snow globes that will impress the judges. Who will win the big cash prize?

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S24/E9 - All-Star Budget'. Guy Fieri invites four superstar chefs to compete in a budget battle. They are put to the test and must make a dollar stretch all competition long.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S31/E9 - Cool For The Summer'. The team serve up easy and tasty recipes to cool things down during the hot days of the summer. They beat the heat with a pickled watermelon and more!

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S53/E5 - All-American Showdown: West'. Renowned chefs from across America compete in a five-part tournament. In this preliminary battle, four culinary greats from the West face off.

programme.title: BBQ Brawl: Flay V. Symon V. Jackson
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Backyard BBQ'. Bobby Flay and Michael Symon suss out the talents of eight elite barbecue masters. Before choosing teams, they compete in a backyard BBQ challenge

programme.title: BBQ Brawl: Flay V. Symon V. Jackson
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - High Steaks'. Bobby Flay and Michael Symon battle it out in a tomahawk rib-eye challenge. Then the six remaining contenders face off in a fierce Texas beef challenge.

programme.title: BBQ Brawl: Flay V. Symon V. Jackson
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Winging It'. Bobby Flay and Michael Symon compete in a regional barbecue challenge. The final four pitmasters are tasked with cooking a style of barbecue unique to an area of the US.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S24/E5 - Summer Grillin' Games Finale'. Guy Fieri throws a big summer bash! The four remaining chefs must find the ingredients for their ultimate grilled feast in an epic scavenger hunt.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S33/E1 - Takeout: Worldwide Delivery'. Guy Fieri combines cooking at home with great restaurant food when four series veterans send ingredients and join him via video chat to cook the recipes.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S33/E2 - Takeout: Bringing Comfort Home'. Guy Fieri cooks grilled cheese from Nashville, pizza from Boulder, CO, Memphis fried chicken and Greek kebabs out of Houston, TX, all via video chat!

programme.title: Dessert Games
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Guilty A La Mode'. Duff Goldman challenges four pastry chefs with a baked-out version of bingo that determines ingredients for a plated cake dish. Which chef will win $10,000?

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S61/E1 - Mizuna Matata'. Four chefs are eager to impress as they race to make appetisers with mizuna and a weird pizza, but first-round jitters are a real problem.

programme.title: Kitchen Crash
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - Battle Of The Block'. In Harrington Park, NJ, a Battle of the Block Party becomes a cooking competition, with chefs making a triple-stacked sandwich and a 5-star meal!

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S35/E10 - French Bistro Faves'. The crew celebrate French bistro classics with a cheese-coated soup, decadent beef, delicious mussels and a signature tart.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S38/E2 - Variety Of Flavor'. Guy Fieri hits up joints with bountiful flavours, including a Malaysian oasis in Cincinnati, a Salvadorian spot in New York and a pizza bus in Omaha.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S59/E10 - Legends: Alex Guarnaschelli'. Four chefs return as favourites of legendary judge Alex Guarnaschelli. A lowbrow but beloved item is in the entrée basket, specially selected by Alex.

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Dockside Desserts'. Jesse Palmer uses his favourite floatie as inspiration for floatie doughnuts in summer flavours! Then, the bakers must make gelatin water feature cakes.

programme.title: Super Mega Cakes
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Best Meal Ever'. Duff Goldman's team and Ashley Holt's team battle to make cakes inspired by their best meal ever and featuring hyper realistic food.

programme.title: Super Mega Cakes

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
